title: both disconnect tests cover identical code path
description: events_coalescing_task_exits_on_disconnect_before_any_broadcast and events_coalescing_task_exits_via_select_closed_arm are intended to test different exit paths (is_closed() vs select\! closed() respectively). In practice both tests exercise only the select\! closed() arm. The first test's Chat broadcast at line 1711 is dead code — the task has already exited before it runs. The two tests provide no additional coverage over each other; one of them is redundant. This is a direct consequence of the wrong oracle comment in KITH-ggjh.1.
